field_principles.adaptation_curve: Per-family (adaptive - static) gain as families stream in -- shows whether adaptation compounds (the continuous-self-learning signature) or is flat.
field_principles.family_count_vs_v395: The held-out family count vs the .395 n=52 -- quantifies the power gain (the .395 CI touched 0 because n was small; a non-touching CI here needs more families).
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefixed. An online/Tier-2 gain AND a now-POWERED static-is-the-ceiling null are BOTH COMPLETE -- both are valid self-learning findings (the powered null retires the ask).
field_principles.model_specs: The Tier-1 online-reweighting rule + the Tier-2 memory rule + the combined family stream; required methodology.
field_principles.online_adaptation_helps: BARE bool: true iff the best adaptive selector (online or Tier-2) exceeds static AND the (adaptive-static) CI95 excludes 0 with power -- the self-learning value verdict the .395 n-limit could not settle.
field_principles.online_cross_family_delta: BARE float: the online-reweighted selector's held-out-family delta -- the Tier-1 self-learning result, now on a powered family set.
field_principles.random_seed: Determinism precondition; the family stream order + reweighting reproducible.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash of the folds + reweighting + memory trace; lets a third party re-run.
field_principles.static_cross_family_delta: BARE float: the static set-encoder's held-out-family delta -- the no-adaptation baseline.
field_principles.tier2_cross_family_delta: BARE float: the constraint-memory (Tier-2) selector's delta -- a distinct self-learning mechanism beyond online reweighting.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: BARE bool=false -- learned selector with online weight updates + a pattern cache, no demo execution and no fine-tuning.

set_encoder_config.architecture_note: Permutation-equivariant DeepSets scorer: per-candidate MLP embedding, mean/max pooled full-set context, and per-candidate logits conditioned on that context.
set_encoder_config.cross_candidate_conditioning: vote priors, self-consistency margins, modal-grid agreement, duplicate counts, shape/palette family indicators, and DeepSets mean/max latent pooling over all candidates
set_encoder_config.imbalance_loss: class_weighted_bce_with_positive_task_minibatches; negative-only tasks are scored held-out but do not form training minibatches
set_encoder_config.set_attention_reference: CPU-fast fallback for the Set-LLM set-attention-mask / Set-Encoder cross-candidate attention lever; still consumes the full candidate set without positional features.

tier1_online_reweighting_rule.current_family_feedback: not used until after every task in that family is scored

tier2_memory_rule.current_family_feedback: cached only after every task in that family is scored
tier2_memory_rule.hardware_path: CPU/system-memory cache lookup, FPGA-friendly pattern match
tier2_memory_rule.lookup: reuse nearest already-seen family's cached selector arm

corrigendum_pending.detail: static_cross_family_delta=0.5 and tier2_cross_family_delta=0.5 agree to >5 sig figs. Two distinct metrics matching this precisely is more likely a bug than a finding.
